n70642a6711.headline: XAU/USD: Gold Steady Near New All-Time High as Markets Await Announcement of New US Tariffs
n70642a6711.summary: Gold held above $3,100 for a second day after reaching a record $3,149 on Tuesday, supported by safe-haven demand amid economic and geopolitical uncertainty.
n70642a6711.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price reflects demand during periods of inflation, currency stress and geopolitical risk.
n70642a6711.why_moved: Strong safe-haven demand amid high economic and geopolitical uncertainty, ahead of expected new US tariff announcements, pushed gold to a record.

n6b001ea0bf.headline: Appropriate responses to tariffs may be needed - Meloni - Politics - Ansa.it
n6b001ea0bf.summary: Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni said the EU may need to adopt appropriate responses to US tariffs while stressing that everything should be done to avert a trade war.
n6b001ea0bf.why: Italy is a major EU exporter, so EU retaliation or negotiation over US tariffs directly affects Italian industry and European trade flows.

n4e6aa82931.headline: Coal India eyeing lithium blocks in Australia, Argentina: Chairman
n4e6aa82931.summary: State-owned Coal India is considering lithium blocks in Australia and Argentina to diversify from coal, the chairman said, while targeting 875 million tonnes of coal output in 2025-26.
n4e6aa82931.why: Coal India is India's largest coal producer, and diversification into battery metals reflects the shift toward clean energy.

ne5040c2385.headline: Thames Water Names Steve Buck as Chief Financial Officer
ne5040c2385.summary: Thames Water appointed Steve Buck as chief financial officer from Monday, replacing Alastair Cochran, who has stepped down, the debt-laden English water company said.
ne5040c2385.why: Thames Water is a heavily indebted UK utility, so leadership changes in its finance function are closely watched by creditors.

nd2fe8d33d9.headline: UniCredit nears launch of Banco BPM bid as Credit Agricole ups stake
nd2fe8d33d9.summary: UniCredit is nearing the launch of a bid for Banco BPM, while Credit Agricole received clearance to take a larger stake in the Italian bank.
nd2fe8d33d9.why: UniCredit and Banco BPM are major Italian lenders, so a takeover contest reshapes the country's banking sector and affects bank shareholders.

impacts.name: UniCredit
impacts.why: UniCredit is the bidder, taking on the cost and execution risk of the offer.

n27be187513.headline: South African rand slides as budget vote puts coalition on shaky ground
n27be187513.summary: The South African rand dropped sharply on Wednesday after a fractious budget vote cast doubt on the solidity of the coalition government. At 1640 GMT, the rand traded at 18.7725 against the dollar.
n27be187513.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and political stability and budget decisions are key drivers of its value and of foreign investor sentiment toward local assets.

impacts.name: South African rand
impacts.why: The rand fell sharply as the budget vote raised doubts about the coalition government's stability.

n27be187513.why_moved: A fractious budget vote raised doubts about the solidity of the coalition government, prompting a sharp fall in the rand.

n7c2ee86ab4.headline: Brazilian President Lula's disapproval rating hits all-time high, poll finds
n7c2ee86ab4.summary: A majority of Brazilians now disapprove of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's performance, a poll showed. Voters are increasingly worried about high inflation ahead of next year's elections.
n7c2ee86ab4.why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy, and political approval and election risk influence fiscal policy expectations and the outlook for the real.

n759cacc969.headline: Gold acts as safety shelter amid Trump’s tariff chaos
n759cacc969.summary: Gold has been the best-performing asset so far this year, gaining nearly 20% and setting repeated record highs, while the S&P 500, Treasury yields and the dollar fell.
n759cacc969.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often attracts demand when equities and currencies are volatile.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Investors are moving into gold as a safe haven during tariff-driven market stress.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

naff9d08a81.headline: UK Trade Associations Urge Government to Prioritize Crypto as a Strategic Focus
naff9d08a81.summary: UK trade bodies are urging the Prime Minister to appoint a crypto and blockchain envoy, citing US policies that they say have driven digital asset growth.
naff9d08a81.why: Government policy on crypto and blockchain affects regulation, investment and where digital asset firms choose to operate.

nbe4744fcb7.headline: Wall St rebounds in choppy trade before Trump tariffs
nbe4744fcb7.summary: US stocks bounced back as investors rushed to position themselves ahead of President Donald Trump's tariff announcement, with trading choppy.
nbe4744fcb7.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of large US companies, and tariff policy affects their costs, export sales and earnings outlooks.
nbe4744fcb7.why_moved: Investors repositioned ahead of President Trump's tariff announcement, lifting US stocks after a choppy session.

n2b8ab55a97.headline: Budget 2025 passed with VAT increase while rand tanks
n2b8ab55a97.summary: Budget 2025 was passed with a VAT increase, and consumers now face higher payments. The rand has tanked at the same time.
n2b8ab55a97.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and VAT changes feed directly into consumer prices and household spending.

ne6836c7041.headline: Wall Street ends up, but Trump tariff speech sends futures lower
ne6836c7041.summary: US stock indexes finished higher after a choppy session on Wednesday, falling early before rebounding. Futures were lower as investors positioned ahead of a tariff speech by President Trump.
ne6836c7041.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US companies, so its direction reflects broad investor sentiment. Tariff announcements matter for corporate costs, trade flows and inflation expectations.
ne6836c7041.why_moved: Futures fell ahead of President Trump's tariff speech, while stocks rebounded from early losses to finish higher. Investors were positioning themselves ahead of the announcement.

na36485ceb6.headline: Spanish pharma company Grifols
na36485ceb6.summary: Grifols shares rose after a report that Brookfield was considering a new takeover attempt. Brookfield told Madrid's market regulator in a filing that it was not in talks with the company.
na36485ceb6.why: Grifols is a Spanish plasma-based pharmaceutical company, and takeover interest from large investors can change its valuation and shareholder base.
na36485ceb6.why_moved: Shares rose after a report that Brookfield was considering a new takeover attempt for the company.

ncd32eec453.headline: Trump’s proposed tariffs loom over major Asian economies; know what’s at stake - OrissaPOST
ncd32eec453.summary: A report from Bangkok says the trade war escalated by US President Donald Trump challenges all Asian economies, large and small, in a region expected to drive global growth.
ncd32eec453.why: Asia is a major hub of export manufacturing, so US tariffs on the region affect global supply chains and trade-exposed companies.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

nde35e48ffd.headline: General Motors (NYSE: GM) Expected to Be Hardest Hit by New Tariffs
nde35e48ffd.summary: General Motors is expected to be the hardest hit by the new tariffs, according to a FinancialContent report.
nde35e48ffd.why: General Motors is a large US automaker with extensive North American production, making it sensitive to tariffs on vehicles and parts.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Tariffs on imported parts and vehicles raise costs for automakers with cross-border supply chains.

nb7ba897c89.headline: Israel lifts all duties on US imports ahead of Trump's expected tariff move
nb7ba897c89.summary: Israel announced the elimination of all duties on imports from the United States. The move comes ahead of an expected tariff action by the Trump administration.
nb7ba897c89.why: Import duties shape the cost of goods traded between countries, and changes in them affect bilateral trade and the competitiveness of exporters.

nd7bee32a87.headline: Trump unveils sweeping 10% tariff and 'reciprocal' tariffs on dozens of nations
nd7bee32a87.summary: Trump announced a sweeping 10% tariff and reciprocal tariffs on dozens of nations, with rates reaching as high as 49%. The measures target trading partners' trade barriers.
nd7bee32a87.why: Tariffs raise the cost of imported goods and can disrupt global supply chains, affecting corporate margins, trade flows and currency and bond markets.
nd7bee32a87.why_moved: The tariffs are a broad trade-policy escalation applying to many countries, with rates described as high as 49% for trading partners judged to have trade barriers.

n54a4043858.headline: France: Military confrontation seems inevitable if no new nuclear deal | The Jerusalem Post
n54a4043858.summary: France's foreign minister warned that a military confrontation with Iran is likely if a nuclear deal is not reached soon.
n54a4043858.why: Tensions involving Iran affect oil supply risk and regional stability, which feed into energy prices and global markets.

n05e8c238a1.headline: Labor wants to give the minimum wage a real boost. The benefits would likely outweigh any downsides
n05e8c238a1.summary: Australia's Labor Party wants to give the minimum wage a real boost, with benefits likely to outweigh downsides. The size of the proposed increase remains in contention.
n05e8c238a1.why: Minimum wage settings affect labour costs for employers across sectors such as retail and hospitality, and feed into inflation and household spending.

n193bf78bc2.headline: Canadian Jews access to kosher wine for Passover harmed by Donald Trump tariff | The Jerusalem Post
n193bf78bc2.summary: Many Canadian consumers are embracing a Buy Canadian movement and avoiding US-made goods in response to Donald Trump's tariffs. Some consumers have no true alternative for kosher wine.
n193bf78bc2.why: US tariffs on Canadian trade and Canadian consumer boycotts of US products affect cross-border trade, retail supply and bilateral trade relations.

n5cb48ab0d2.headline: DWP confirms first three benefits to face new bank checks crackdown
n5cb48ab0d2.summary: A new bill will give the Department for Work and Pensions the power to require banks to check whether claimants are entitled to benefits, with the first three benefits set to be covered.
n5cb48ab0d2.why: Rules requiring banks to take on verification duties change compliance costs for lenders and the operation of UK welfare payments.

nc19858a4e7.headline: States say Trump's continued freeze on much-needed FEMA aid violates a judge's order
nc19858a4e7.summary: Twenty-two states say the Trump administration is illegally freezing FEMA funding in violation of a judge's order. The administration says the funds are under review, not frozen.
nc19858a4e7.why: FEMA disburses federal disaster and emergency aid to states, so funding freezes affect state budgets and recovery spending.

n53211c87df.headline: The war of duties alarms the "made in Italy": fashion, wines and food. Risks on exports for 67 billion
n53211c87df.summary: US duties threaten Italian wine, food and fashion exports, and the country's car industry is already heavily affected, according to the report. Risks to exports are put at 67 billion.
n53211c87df.why: Italy's wine, food, fashion and automotive sectors are major export earners, so US tariffs on them directly affect Italian manufacturing and trade income.

n584dce118c.headline: Gisborne beef and sheep station sells for $8.23m
n584dce118c.summary: Rimunui Station in Gisborne sold for $8.23 million, a sale described as reflecting a rebound in confidence across the rural property market.
n584dce118c.why: Rural property prices in New Zealand reflect farm income, lending conditions and investor confidence in the agricultural sector.

n0d6ec5bd58.headline: Australia braces for impact of Trump tariffs on imports
n0d6ec5bd58.summary: Australian party leaders are weighing the effects as Donald Trump prepares to announce a new round of tariffs. The tariffs could affect Australian imports.
n0d6ec5bd58.why: Australia is an open trading economy, so US tariff changes can affect its export demand, currency and commodity-linked sectors. Investors watch trade policy for these spillovers.

n34371fb11b.headline: UK in talks over US car tariffs, could look at EV incentives, Reeves says
n34371fb11b.summary: Britain is working intensely with Washington to secure an exemption from US auto tariffs. Chancellor Rachel Reeves said the government could review a credit scheme that indirectly benefits Tesla.
n34371fb11b.why: Auto tariffs raise costs for carmakers that export across the Atlantic, affecting manufacturers, suppliers and trade flows. Tesla is the largest pure-play electric carmaker and a frequent subject of EV incentive debates.

nfcc0f39549.headline: Japan's Terra Drone to boost cooperation with Saudi Aramco for inspections
nfcc0f39549.summary: Japan's Terra Drone plans to boost cooperation with Saudi Aramco on inspections. Terra Drone set up a Saudi subsidiary in 2023 after raising $14 million from Aramco's venture arm, Wa'ed Ventures.
nfcc0f39549.why: Saudi Aramco is the state-controlled oil producer of Saudi Arabia, and its inspection and maintenance contracts matter to service providers.

n589293fe1a.headline: Share market update: Most active stocks in today
n589293fe1a.summary: The NSE Nifty index closed 166.65 points higher at 23,332.35, according to the market update, which also listed the most active stocks of the day.
n589293fe1a.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

n4c5b454203.headline: It's been a wild rollout of Trump's tariffs. Here's how we got here
n4c5b454203.summary: President Donald Trump's tariff agenda has featured frequent threats, several of which were later backed off or had deadlines shifted. An overview traces how the rollout has unfolded.
n4c5b454203.why: Tariffs are taxes on imports that affect trade flows, corporate costs and inflation, so the timing and scope of US tariff policy is a core driver of global market sentiment.

n7644b2d940.headline: Inflation casts shadow over Japan’s cherry blossom season
n7644b2d940.summary: A report shows the cost of typical food items eaten at flower-viewing gatherings in Japan has risen 21.4% over the past six years, highlighting inflation's impact on households.
n7644b2d940.why: Food price inflation shapes consumer spending and the Bank of Japan's policy decisions, which affect yields and the yen.

naa059ffcdc.headline: President Trump Unveils New Tariffs On 'Liberation Day'
naa059ffcdc.summary: President Trump announced new tariffs during a press conference in the Rose Garden at the White House. The tariffs were presented as 'Liberation Day' measures.
naa059ffcdc.why: US tariffs change import costs and trade flows across global supply chains, affecting exporters, importers and currency markets. The White House announcements often set the tone for broader trade negotiations.
naa059ffcdc.why_moved: The announcement of new US tariffs raises trade-policy uncertainty for companies and markets exposed to import costs and global trade. The input does not give market reaction figures.

nb19fe8f2f6.headline: Russia Using Cook Islands’ Registry to Mask Its ‘Shadow Fleet,’ New Zealand Says
nb19fe8f2f6.summary: Emails from New Zealand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs reveal concerns that Russia is using the Cook Islands' shipping registry to avoid sanctions on its shadow fleet.
nb19fe8f2f6.why: Shadow fleet tankers carry sanctioned Russian oil, and flag registries used to obscure ownership affect enforcement of oil price cap sanctions. This matters for global crude flows and shipping risk.

nf6f6468977.headline: BoJ's Ueda: US tariffs pose short-term inflation risk, long-term growth uncertainty
nf6f6468977.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said the effects of US tariff policy remain highly uncertain and could significantly affect global trade. He flagged short-term inflation risk and long-term growth uncertainty.
nf6f6468977.why: The Bank of Japan sets the policy interest rate for Japan's economy and influences the yen and Japanese government bond yields. Its comments on tariffs signal how it may weigh inflation against growth.

n6c321f6140.headline: Trump Reciprocal Tariffs: Yen outperforms major peers fuelled by haven bids - CNBC TV18
n6c321f6140.summary: The yen gained as much as 0.7% to 148.17 per dollar in Tokyo. Japan faces a 24% rate under Trump's reciprocal tariffs on trading partners.
n6c321f6140.why: The yen is Japan's currency and often attracts safe-haven demand during trade tensions. Its moves affect exporters, import costs and Japanese investors' overseas returns.
n6c321f6140.why_moved: Trump's reciprocal tariffs on US trading partners, including a 24% rate on Japan, drove haven bids into the yen, per the report.

n1c6fdeabb1.headline: A May BOJ hike would be too early given tariffs and wages, DPP says
n1c6fdeabb1.summary: A DPP view holds that a May Bank of Japan hike would be too early given tariffs and wages. Most economists expect the next increase in June or July, though many say May is possible.
n1c6fdeabb1.why: Bank of Japan rate decisions set the cost of borrowing in Japan and influence the yen and Japanese government bond yields. Timing expectations move these markets.

ncdb7b1aec8.headline: Tax Systems acquired by Providence Equity Partners
ncdb7b1aec8.summary: Private equity firm Providence is acquiring UK tax compliance software leader Tax Systems to accelerate European product expansion. Deal terms were not disclosed in the input.
ncdb7b1aec8.why: Providence Equity Partners is a US private equity firm that buys and grows software businesses, and tax compliance software is a recurring-revenue niche.

n095ca8f4fd.headline: Poultry markets strong, but geopolitical risks loom - Rabobank
n095ca8f4fd.summary: Rabobank expects global poultry trade to remain strong, with relatively tight supply, but flagged that geopolitical risks loom over the sector.
n095ca8f4fd.why: Rabobank is a Dutch agricultural lender that publishes sector outlooks widely followed by food and commodity investors.

n99b4983082.headline: World Bank lends $800 million for Philippines energy transition
n99b4983082.summary: The World Bank has approved an $800 million loan supporting reforms that promote the shift to clean energy and climate resilience in the Philippines.
n99b4983082.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose loans fund infrastructure and policy reform, shaping energy investment opportunities in developing economies.

n0c71157bba.headline: Positive leads on inflation lift stocks
n0c71157bba.summary: Share prices surged after a one-day break, supported by positive expectations for the country's March inflation data, a strong start to the second quarter.
n0c71157bba.why: Inflation data shapes expectations for central bank interest rate decisions, which affect equity valuations and borrowing costs.
n0c71157bba.why_moved: Share prices rose after a one-day break on positive expectations for March inflation data.

naa0aa6d0b0.headline: Ayala seals GCash investment deal with Mitsubishi for P18.4 billion
naa0aa6d0b0.summary: Ayala Corp. and Mitsubishi Corp. executed an investment agreement for Mitsubishi's acquisition of a 6.5% stake in e-wallet GCash, valued at P18.4 billion.
naa0aa6d0b0.why: Ayala is a major Philippine conglomerate, and Mitsubishi Corp. is a Japanese trading and investment group; GCash is a leading Philippine digital payments platform.

n7cf1e8c266.headline: 'Good news': PM Shehbaz to make 'surprising announcement' tomorrow
n7cf1e8c266.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is expected to announce a decision after meeting businessmen in Islamabad. The IMF had approved a reduction of Re1 per unit in power tariffs.
n7cf1e8c266.why: Power tariffs affect industrial costs and the fiscal programme agreed with the International Monetary Fund.

n34a030d2eb.headline: Aboitiz to spend P101 billion for expansion this year
n34a030d2eb.summary: The Aboitiz Group is preparing to spend at least P101 billion this year to support growth across its business units. The spending plan covers its various power and infrastructure businesses.
n34a030d2eb.why: Aboitiz is a Philippine conglomerate with interests in power generation and distribution, so its capital plans signal domestic infrastructure investment.

nc662f67f76.headline: TSX climbs to eight-day high ahead of U.S. tariff reveal
nc662f67f76.summary: Canada's main stock index rose to its highest close in over a week, helped by gains in industrial and technology shares, as investors awaited Trump's tariff announcement.
nc662f67f76.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main benchmark index, and it has large exposure to resource and financial stocks.
nc662f67f76.why_moved: Gains in industrial and technology shares lifted the index while investors awaited details of the expected US tariff announcement.

nee25b1bc8f.headline: Companies preparing for tariff turbulence as U.S. set to announce latest round
nee25b1bc8f.summary: Canadian companies have stockpiled goods, cut staff and put projects on hold as the U.S. prepares its latest round of tariffs. Firms are bracing for economic turbulence.
nee25b1bc8f.why: Tariff-driven caution by businesses reduces investment and hiring, which feeds into Canada's economic growth outlook.

n6a4ce0d14f.headline: Canadian farmland values climb steadily in 2024
n6a4ce0d14f.summary: Canadian farmland values rose steadily in 2024, with demand staying firm despite higher costs and market uncertainty.
n6a4ce0d14f.why: Farmland is a major real asset for agricultural producers and investors. Land values influence farm financing, credit conditions and rural wealth.
